meta.description: Per-model rf-mcp instruction-quality baselines for the agentic e2e gate. Lowering a number here is a human-reviewed ratchet: it means rf-mcp's tool descriptions / MCP instructions got measurably worse for a fixed model. Only scenarios marked _validated:true hard-gate (calibrated + monotonic-sensitive per the validation canary). Recapture with E2E_CAPTURE_BASELINE=1.
meta.aggregation: median for rates, mean for completion
meta.capture_command: MINIMAX_API_KEY=... E2E_CAPTURE_BASELINE=1 E2E_RUNS=5 E2E_MODELS=MiniMax-M3 uv run pytest tests/e2e/test_minimax_autonomous.py

reference_pin.note: GOAL: a pinnable self-hostable reference (qwen3-coder-30b, single 24GB GPU @ Q4) to kill baseline drift. FINDING (apply): OpenRouter DEFAULT routing for qwen3-coder is NOT reproducible — it intermittently returns prose with ZERO tool calls (N=3: success [0,0,1]). Realizing the self-hostable reference requires OpenRouter provider PINNING or actual self-hosting; until then MiniMax-M3 is the active reference (proven 3/3 reliable) and open-weight models run inform-only for trend.
